# Field blocks for Bavaria, Germany

Germany, Bavaria (blocks) field boundaries (2026) as fiboa GeoParquet + PMTiles, mirrored by Fields of the World from Bayerisches Staatsministerium für Ernährung, Landwirtschaft, Forsten und Tourismus. License: CC-BY-4.0.

- Latest: https://data.source.coop/ftw/harmonized-field-data/de_by_block/latest/de_by_block.parquet
- All editions: s3://ftw/harmonized-field-data/de_by_block/year=*/*.parquet (S3 via endpoint https://data.source.coop, path style, anonymous; hive_partitioning=true adds `year`)
- CRS EPSG:25832; `metrics:area` in m²; `year` = edition, `id` unique per edition only.
- Columns: crop:name, flik, crop:code, id, determination:datetime, crop:name_en, geometry, metrics:area, bbox
- Docs: https://source.coop/ftw/harmonized-field-data/de_by_block/README.md, agent guide https://source.coop/ftw/harmonized-field-data/de_by_block/AGENTS.md, STAC https://data.source.coop/ftw/harmonized-field-data/de_by_block/collection.json
